name: H8 - Asymmetric Terrain: One Side Has Cover Advantage
hypothesis: H8: When one team spawns with cover and the other in the open (on an otherwise symmetric map), the team with cover has a significant advantage in survival and damage dealt.
description: Two InfantrySquads per team on an asymmetric map where the northern half has a cover wall (one side can use it, the other must cross open ground to engage). Blue spawns in open south, Red spawns behind cover in north.
expected_observations: Red (with cover) should win >60% of engagements. Average damage dealt by Red should be higher than Blue. The cover_ratio mechanic should measurably reduce hit probability against Red units positioned near walls.
